notes.title: New Area, The Woods
notes.content:
For the first Rocket Ghost Aidan update, we went all out! A whole new world with a new song is being added. In it are 8 well made hand crafted levels, with a slight increase of difficulty than the average level. To access these levels, you just have to collect 290 nectar coins. Then they will be able to access a place with the teleporter to the new world located in the upper left of the hub. At the end of the 8 levels, a new power up will be there, you will be able to access whenever you're at max health!   

Update coming 4/25/21!!!
